support_and_fastening: one continuous chain supports one tag from the neck
orientation: tag hangs vertically with a small pose-responsive swing

relative_dimensions.length: about one and one half tag widths
relative_dimensions.diameter_or_span: not applicable; use tag width and chain loop span

repeated_elements.unit_size: chain link or bead about one eighth of tag width
repeated_elements.spacing: small clear gap between repeated units
repeated_elements.count_logic: enough repeated units to close one continuous neck loop

shape_and_construction: rounded rectangular plate with one top hole and one continuous chain
material_and_finish: brushed metal with compact hard highlights
layer_order: over fur skin or shirt and behind any foreground arm that crosses it
body_and_garment_clearance: tag rests on the chest and remains separate from neckline and fur
contact_and_pose_response: chain and tag follow gravity and chest contact without floating
articulation_and_mobility: small swing and rotation around the chain attachment
visibility_and_occlusion: visible in declared anchor views; record deliberate arm or crop occlusion
continuity_rules: one tag remains attached to one continuous chain
size and centerline placement remain stable
diagnostic_misreadings: tag fused into shirt or fur
